subject: Manual testing, test automation and digital accessibility
location_languages:
Gothenburg area
Languages · Swedish, Norwegian and English
intro: I’m in the final months of my software testing course at IT-Högskolan in Gothenburg. During my internship at Sportson, I write acceptance tests, test the website manually and automate test cases. I’ve also built tools to speed up the manual checks I run regularly.
career_change: Before I got into testing, I worked as a chef in restaurants and a hospital kitchen in Norway. I led the weekend shifts and trained new staff. In the kitchen, I learned to pitch in wherever I was needed and to check my work before handing it over. I still work that way. I chose software testing because I wanted to work in IT and focus on quality.

internship.title: Software testing intern - Sportson
internship.description:
Manual testing · I confirmed with the product owner that search only had to support product names. I chose test data and checked that the expected product appeared.
Test automation · When a date check stopped a test early, I adjusted the check with AI assistance. Both affected tests passed on the next run.
Accessibility · As I tabbed through the main menu, the focus indicator disappeared on some links. I reported the bug to the developer. After the fix, I retested the menu and could see which link had focus.

contrast_project: Text Contrast Checker shows the text colour, background colour and contrast ratio for selected text.
zoom_project: Zoom Profiles saves zoom levels so I can repeat layout checks with the same settings.
tools: Unit testing · JUnit and Mockito, with JaCoCo for code coverage
Requirements and test management · ReQtest, Jira and Azure DevOps
Programming · Java, Python, Go (Golang), HTML and JavaScript
Development environments · VS Code, PyCharm, IntelliJ IDEA and Zed
Version control and builds · Git, GitHub, Docker, Jenkins and CI/CD pipelines
Other technologies · Windows, Linux distributions, a home server with TrueNAS and QNAP, and 3D printing
personal: In my spare time, I tinker with my home server, make things with my 3D printer and play video games. I get a lot of energy from working with other people, especially when we’re learning something new together.
courses: Test methods, requirements management and testing in agile teams.
Test automation with Playwright and Robot Framework.
Java, unit testing and test-driven development.
Test environments for embedded systems and AI, CAN communication and testing AI systems.
